description: This file defines a custom theme class 'RetroTheme' for a Flutter application. It provides static methods to generate light and dark theme data, configuring color schemes, app bar, card, dialog, button, chip, and divider styles to achieve a retro or vintage aesthetic.

classes.name: RetroTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate customized light and dark themes for a Flutter app with a retro color palette.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured for light mode with the retro color scheme.

methods.name: dark
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured for dark mode with the retro color scheme.

methods.name: _base
methods.description: Internal helper method that constructs ThemeData based on provided ColorScheme and scaffold background color.
